Small documents for the text extraction tests (ADR 0013). All contain the same made-up text
(German with umlauts, Cyrillic and Greek lines in the Writer ones).

- `chrome-3pages.pdf`: printed from HTML by Chrome (fonts with ToUnicode maps), 3 pages.
- `libreoffice-writer.pdf`, `a.docx`, `a.odt`: LibreOffice Writer, same text.
- `t.xlsx`, `p.pptx`, `t.ods`, `p.odp`: written by hand to the formats' specifications (shared strings and inline strings, rich-text runs, slides, `text:s` and `text:tab`).
